title: Length, mass & capacity units
examples: Teacher, when should I use centimeters instead of meters?
What is the difference between grams and kilograms?
If I need to measure juice, which unit should I pick?

explain.say: You can measure how long, how heavy, or how much a thing holds. Each one has its own units.
Length is how long a thing is. You measure a pencil in centimetres. You measure a room in metres.
One metre is the same as one hundred centimetres. A big step for a grown-up is about one metre.
Mass is how heavy a thing is. A bag of sugar is about one kilogram. Light things are measured in grams.
Capacity is how much a container holds. A big carton of milk holds one litre. Small amounts are measured in millilitres.
Pick a small unit for small things. Pick a big unit for big things.

faq.q: When do I use millimetres for length?
faq.a: You use millimetres for very small lengths. An example is the width of a crayon.
asks: What is the smallest length unit?
When is mm the right unit to pick?

faq.q: Should I use grams or kilograms for weight?
faq.a: Use grams for light things, like a few paper clips. Use kilograms for heavier things, like a person or a large bag of rice.
asks: Which unit is better for a puppy?
Is it always better to use kilograms?

faq.q: What is the difference between ml and L?
faq.a: Millilitres are for small amounts of liquid, like a spoonful of medicine. Litres are for bigger amounts, like a carton of milk.
asks: How do I measure a small drink?
When should I use the big unit, liters?

faq.q: How do I choose the right unit?
faq.a: Look at the object you measure. If it is very small, use the smaller unit. If it is big, use the larger unit.
asks: Do I always go big or small?
What helps me decide which unit to pick?

faq.q: Can I mix units when measuring?
faq.a: Use one kind of unit for one measurement. For length, use only length units, like centimetres or metres.
asks: Can I measure length in grams?
Do I need to change units when I measure?

facts: One metre is equal to one hundred centimetres.
One kilogram is equal to one thousand grams.
One litre is equal to one thousand millilitres.
Kilometres measure long distances, like the distance between towns.

quiz.say: Tap the best unit to measure the length of a classroom.
quiz.why: A classroom is a few metres long. Metres are a good unit for a room.

wrong.0: Centimetres are for small things, like a pencil.
wrong.2: Kilometres are for long trips, like from one town to the next.

quiz.say: Tap the best unit to weigh a bag of potatoes.
quiz.why: A bag of potatoes is heavy. Kilograms measure heavy things.

wrong.0: Litres measure how much liquid a container holds.
wrong.1: Grams are for light things, like a leaf or a pencil.

quiz.say: Tap the unit that measures the milk in a carton.
quiz.why: Litres measure how much liquid a container holds. A big carton holds 1 litre.

wrong.1: Metres measure how long a thing is.
wrong.2: Kilograms measure how heavy a thing is.
